disagreements.title: Opening done.html directly shows a fake reference DR-000000
disagreements.a_reason: The review reproduced this. A resident who reopens the done page, for example from history or a bookmark, is shown a made-up reference as if it were real and could take it to the gate. This is not D14, which is about the day, slot and vehicle missing from the page.
disagreements.b_reason: This is a direct-URL edge case. The review shows no path by which a resident reaches done.html without booking, so the harm is speculative.

assertions.text: The reply puts the fixes in priority order and says what needs a person
